title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: setting up, running and stopping an automatic transfer from checking
content:
## Policy clause

1. **What it is.** An automatic transfer moves a fixed amount each month from a Piedmont Crescent Bank checking account into a Savings & Money Market Accounts account.
2. **Whose instruction.** Setting up or changing it is the owner's own instruction to move their funds.
3. **Funding account.** The funding checking account must belong to the same customer as the savings account and must be in active status when the instruction is recorded.
4. **Amount.** The amount must be at least the tier's minimum automatic transfer amount.
5. **Day.** The transfer day is a day of the month from 1 to 28. When that day is not a business day, the transfer runs on the next business day.
6. **Running.** On the transfer day the transfer posts to the savings account as an automatic transfer deposit and debits the funding checking account. If the checking ledger balance would go below zero, the transfer is skipped for that month, with no entry and no fee; it never creates an overdraft.
7. **Stopping.** Stopping the transfer sets the amount to USD 0.00 and clears the day and the funding account, effective for the next scheduled run.

## Basis of decision

- **Authority.** Ownership and status of the funding checking account are read from the bank's checking records at the moment the instruction is recorded; the minimum amount is that of the savings account's tier on the account record.
- **Object correlation.** The funding checking account and the receiving savings account must carry the same customer.

## Instruction checklist

| Item | Must hold |
|---|---|
| Funding checking account owner | same customer as the savings account |
| Funding checking account status | active when the instruction is recorded |
| Monthly amount | at least the tier's minimum automatic transfer amount |
| Transfer day | a day of the month from 1 to 28 |

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

- **Weekend day.** The transfer day is the 6th and the 6th falls on a Saturday. The transfer runs on the next business day.
- **Insufficient checking funds.** On the transfer day the funding checking account's ledger balance is lower than the transfer amount, so the debit would take it below zero. The transfer is skipped for that month; nothing posts to either account and no fee is charged.
- **Day 30 requested.** The owner asks for the 30th of each month. The 30th is outside the 1 to 28 range, so it cannot be the transfer day.
- **Spouse's checking account.** The owner names a checking account that belongs to another customer. The funding account must belong to the same customer, so it cannot fund the transfer.

## Points of judgement

**When does a stop take effect?** For the next scheduled run.

**Can an automatic transfer overdraw the checking account?** No; it is skipped instead.
